request.input:
1girl, 1boy, two adults, close three-quarter shot, landscape. Figures fill canvas edge to edge; lower legs and skirt cropped.

Seated woman foreground right overlaps warrior behind left; similar head sizes. He leans forward over her shoulder, brows lowered, stern stare. She sits sideways, face turned toward viewer, unreadable expression, hands on book in lap. His right fingers grip cup handle near mouth; left palm supports saucer below chest. Two books float behind her shoulders.

Dark upper half. Narrow cool sidelight from left catches faces and sleeves, bright lower skirt; his far eye and half torso lost in solid black. Dark paneled wall, stone base. Muted jade, bone white, ink black, gold and orange accents, weighty fabric, intimidating stillness.
